content.what_it_is: MATLAB analysis script for the FUNWAVE-TVD single_vessel_cohesive case (vessel wakes over cohesive sediment); a 2-panel variant of the multi_vessel plot_morpho_avg_setup.m. Loads dep_00000 from local output/ (L3, L6), mirrors the half-domain N=2*n-1 (L9, L35-L36), dx=dy=1.0 (L12-L13). For snapshot nfile=[120] (L20; 3-snapshot set commented L19, labels mint L21) loads eta_, mask_, C_ and only the suspended-load bed change DchgS_ (L44-L47; no DchgB_ — cohesive sediment has no bed load here), masks eta and ch (L49-L50), mirrors ETA/CH/BEDS (L53-L59) and sets BB=BEDS (L61). Two tight_subplot panels (L38) with ax=[0 4500 0 120] (L39): (1) concentration CH pcolor in linear scale, caxis [0 1.2], colorbar ' C (g/L) ' (L63-L70); (2) contourf of dZ_sus with caxis [-0.0005 0.0005] (L74-L82); colormap jet(12) (L87); printed to wakes_cohesive_morpho.jpg (L90). Second figure (L91-L117): laterally averaged bed change B(j)=mean(BB(j,:)) (L93-L95), eta envelopes MaxH/MinH (L97-L98), subplot(211) B vs y with axis [0 120 -0.004 0.002] (L100-L105), subplot(212) initial depth profile -DEP(:,1), still-water dashed line between y=15.7 and 102.32, and the eta envelopes (L106-L115); printed to section_mean_wave_morpho.jpg (L117).
entities: B laterally averaged bed change L94
unresolved: concentration is plotted in linear g/L with caxis [0 1.2] (L65-L66, L69) without the 2680*1000 conversion used in the multi_vessel sibling; whether the model's C output unit differs between cases or the label is inconsistent cannot be determined here
BEDB is allocated (L31) but never loaded or used; BB=BEDS only (L61) consistent with cohesive (suspended-only) transport
mint labels (L21) are never used since nfile has one entry; the still-water extent [15.7 102.32] (L109) is hard-coded as in the multi_vessel script
tight_subplot is an external dependency; second-figure axis limits [0 120 ...] (L105, L115) bound y although N=2n-1 rows imply y up to N-1 which may exceed 120
